statBlock.name: Steel Predator
statBlock.description: A renegade hexton in Sigil builds these steel assassins to pursue a chosen quarry across planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Modron and its owner's language. It cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison and psychic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The predator has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The predator casts with Wisdom and requires no components.
3/day each. Dimension Door and Plane Shift, both self only.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.
Stunning Roar (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) thunder damage, drops everything it holds and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage. A stunned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the stun on a success.
sections.Pursuit: To build a predator, the hexton needs a personal item linked to the quarry. The predator detects the quarry across planes to within about 1,000 yards and uses sight and smell to close the remaining distance. It targets the quarry unless another creature blocks its way. It normally returns to Sigil for disassembly afterward. A damaged predator may stay behind and hunt lookalikes or nearby creatures.
sections.Constructed nature: The predator needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

statBlock.name: Stone Cursed
statBlock.description: An alchemist can animate a petrified humanoid as a loyal guardian. Fragments of the victim’s memories survive in an obsidian skull inside it.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Traits:
Cunning Opportunist. The stone cursed has advantage on opportunity attack rolls.
False Appearance. While motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary statue.
sections.Actions: Petrifying Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) if the attack roll had advantage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it begins turning to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure petrifies it for 24 hours. A success ends the effect.
sections.Cryptic Whispers: When the stone cursed dies, its body shatters and reveals its obsidian skull. At the end of a short rest, a character can ask the skull a question aloud and try a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, a memory answers the question. The skull can be used this way only once, even if the check fails.
sections.Constructed nature: The stone cursed needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

statBlock.name: Stone Defender
statBlock.description: Riveted stone plates let this clockwork bodyguard blend into rough masonry and shield nearby allies.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator. It cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without adamantine weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless against rough earth or stone, the defender is indistinguishable from that surface.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it falls prone.
sections.Reactions: Intercept Attack. When another creature within 5 ft. is hit by an attack roll, the defender can grant it +5 AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. The defender must see both attacker and target.
sections.Clockwork enhancements:
For an individual clockwork, choose or roll one enhancement and one potential malfunction, both on d10.
1. Camouflaged. Gain Stealth proficiency if needed. While still, the clockwork passes for an inactive machine.
2. Sensors. Raise darkvision to at least 120 ft. and add Perception proficiency if needed.
3. Improved Armor. Increase AC by 2.
4. Increased Speed. Increase speed by 10 ft.
5. Reinforced Construction. Gain resistance to force, lightning and thunder damage.
6. Self-Repairing. At the start of its turn, recover 5 HP if it has at least 1 HP. Lightning damage skips the next recovery.
7. Sturdy Frame. Add its number of Hit Dice to its maximum HP.
8. Suction. Gain a 30-ft. climbing speed.
9. Vocal Resonator. It speaks rudimentary Common or Gnomish, as its maker decides.
10. Water Propulsion. Gain a 30-ft. swimming speed.
sections.Clockwork malfunctions:
1. Faulty Sensors. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, the clockwork is blinded until turn end.
2. Flawed Targeting. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, its attack rolls have disadvantage until turn end.
3. Ground Fault. Gain vulnerability to lightning damage.
4. Imprinting Loop. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it mistakes a visible creature within 30 ft. for its maker. It avoids harming that creature for 1 minute or until the creature attacks or damages it.
5. Leaking Lubricant. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it gains one level of exhaustion despite immunity.
6. Limited Steering. It moves in straight lines, turning up to 90 degrees before moving and once at the halfway point. It can rotate freely on a turn when it uses none of its speeds.
7. Overactive Sense of Self-Preservation. At the start of a combat turn while at half HP or less, roll a d6. On a 1, the clockwork retreats if it can. If it cannot retreat, it keeps fighting.
8. Overheats. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it is incapacitated until turn end.
9. Rusty Gears. It has disadvantage on initiative rolls and its speed drops by 10 ft.
10. Weak Armor. Remove its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine attacks.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 126, with Clockwork customization on p. 124.

statBlock.name: Summer Eladrin
statBlock.description: An eladrin in its summer aspect moves quickly and pours its anger into burning weapon strikes.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Fearsome Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of this eladrin for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success. When the effect ends or the creature succeeds on the save, it is immune to any eladrin's Fearsome Presence for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) using two hands, plus 4 (1d8) fire damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Parry. The eladrin adds 3 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it. It must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Printing notes: The printed stat block lists passive Perception 9. The usual calculation from its Wisdom score gives 11.

statBlock.name: Sword Wraith Commander
statBlock.description: A disgraced officer's ghost leads fallen soldiers in pursuit of a victory that will restore its honor.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) using two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Call to Honor (1/Day). The commander can use this action only after taking damage in the current combat. It gains advantage on attack rolls through the end of its next turn. Roll 1d4 + 1 to determine how many Sword Wraith Warriors appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They act immediately after the commander's turn on its initiative count and remain until they drop to 0 hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one weapon attack. A hit deals an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. After it uses Martial Fury, attack rolls against the wraith have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Undead nature: The wraith needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Traits: Turning Defiance. The commander and other Sword Wraiths within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.

statBlock.name: Sword Wraith Warrior
statBlock.description: A fallen warrior returns as an armed ghost, still guarding its reputation and spoiling for battle.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) using two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one weapon attack. After it uses Martial Fury, attack rolls against the wraith have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Undead nature: The wraith needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

statBlock.name: The Angry
statBlock.description: This two-headed sorrowsworn feeds on violence. The heads bicker until something gives them a reason to fight.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Two Heads. The Angry has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious.
Rising Anger. When another creature damages the Angry, its attack rolls gain advantage through the end of its next turn. The first Hook hit on that next turn deals an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage. The Angry has disadvantage on attack rolls on its turn if no other creature has damaged it since the end of its previous turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.
